title: 第3章破山第4章凡骨第5章入道
slug: 天行健君子以自强不息
content_zh:
【剧情回顾】
陈石头死在了冶炼炉旁。
掌心死死扣着一枚漆黑灵引，和沈青私藏的那枚别无二致。他脸上纠缠着极致的恐惧，又透着一丝癫狂的狂喜，模样诡异至极。
灵引择主，绝非凡人可随意触碰。这是沈青的原话。
林天行猛然回想雪夜濒死的经历，地底那阵诡异的脉动，分明和陈石头死前的征兆完全契合。
受赵世昌所托探矿的张道人，并未就此离去。他扎根黑石山坡，日夜紧盯矿脉，不肯放过半点异动。
异变，爆发在三月二十的子夜。
道人的罗盘指针疯狂旋飞，细碎电光滋滋炸裂。他掐诀推演瞬息，面色骤煞惨白。哪里是什么地脉异动！分明是一尊沉睡万古的太古存在，即将破封苏醒！
天地异象同步席卷整片大陆。擎天峰古钟无风自鸣；东海千丈巨浪凭空开裂；北域冻土滚出远古兽吼；南疆妖皇石室裂出细纹；西域万年石像垂落猩红血泪。
乱世大局，已然拉开序幕。
唯独黑石矿场的林天行，对此全然无知。深夜翻身，沉眠不醒。地心深处的万古存在，正以他的心跳为唯一坐标，一寸寸挣脱厚重岩层的禁锢。
只差最后一丝契机，便可现世。
---
四月初三，沈青蛰伏半载的复仇计划，终于掀开真面目。
当日收工，他没有回奴仆棚屋。趁着浓稠夜色，悄然潜至矿场西侧废渣堆。林天行悄悄尾随，看清眼前景象，心头骤然一紧。
废渣堆后，竟蹲聚了七八道身影。
全是矿场底层挣扎的苦力奴仆。大半人他都熟识：憨厚的李大柱、跛脚拉矿的孙瘸子、伙房忙活的赵寡妇。余下几张生面孔，衣着破败，看着是城里走投无路的穷苦匠人。
沈青立在人群正中，掌心摊开一张粗布手绘的矿场布局图。半截烛光摇曳明暗，他捏着炭条，在布面重重标出四个关键点位。
“北侧侧门，夜间仅一名守卫值守。”沈青压低声线，字字利落，“子时三刻换岗，空出半盏茶无人值守的窗口期，这是我们唯一的进门机会。”
炭条在布面划出一道长线。

“西侧护矿营房常驻十六人。这帮人夜夜酗酒酣睡，真正能起身应战的，不足五人。南侧赵管事卧房，枕头下藏着铜钥匙，能开正堂的核心铁柜。”
“铁柜里有三样东西。”沈青抬眼，目光扫过众人，“全员矿奴的卖身契、赵家偷税克扣的黑账本、官商勾结的密信。”
眼底压抑已久的恨意，骤然锋芒毕露。
“拿到这三样，赵家就彻底垮了！卖身契能解放所有奴工；黑账本能捣毁赵家所有产业；密信能拖垮天青城一众贪官。证据张贴菜市口，全城皆知，无人能救赵家！”
李大柱舔了舔干裂的嘴唇，眼底藏着怯意：“护矿队几十号人持刀在手，我们手无寸铁，拿什么硬闯？”
沈青不语，缓缓从怀中摸出一物。
巴掌大的铜镜，镜面暗沉无光，边缘刻着一圈晦涩古纹，无人能辨源流。他将铜镜平放地面，取出漆黑灵引，紧紧贴合镜背。
石身裂缝中，一缕金纹骤然亮起。
镜面瞬间漾开层层涟漪，如静水落雨。镜中无人无影，只剩浓稠暗红雾气缓缓翻涌，扑面而来的尽是诡异的压迫感。
“这是什么法器？”林天行低声发问，心底莫名发沉。
“张道人的私藏。”沈青唇角勾起一抹冷冽弧度，“那老道把我当成赵家探子，全无防备。我陪他连饮三日，套出了不少修行门道。”
“这是他炼制的低阶迷障法器。”沈青轻点镜面，“注入灵力便可笼罩半座矿场，凡人入障即刻昏睡。时辰一到自动消散，不留半点痕迹。”
他补了一句，语气平淡却极具分量：“那老张是正经修士。修为不高，碾压凡人，绰绰有余。”
林天行凝望着那面泛红光的铜镜，疑云丛生。
一块无名奇石，竟能驱动修士法器？这灵引的来头，到底有多恐怖？
他压下满腹疑惑，静静听着安排。沈青的部署，缜密得毫无破绽。
“李大柱，你力气最大，带两人守北门，解决换岗守卫。”
“孙瘸子，你熟稔矿场所有地形。带两人蹲守营房外，迷障铺开后，第一时间收缴所有兵器。”
“赵寡妇，你负责递送管事膳食。这包蒙汗药你收好，今晚下入他的饭菜即可。药量精准，足够他昏睡至明日正午。”
最后，沈青转头看向林天行。

“天行，你随我进正堂。”
“只有我们两个？”林天行微怔。
“只有我们两个。”沈青眼神坚定，“正堂证据关乎所有人的性命，知晓者越少，风险越低。拿到东西由你带出矿场，一旦出事，后山排水沟是唯一生路。”
“那你呢？”
沈青沉默片刻，笑意浅淡却决绝刺骨：“我这条命，早就是捡来的。出事，便认命。”
content_en:
【Plot review】
Chen Shitou died next to the smelting furnace.
Holding tightly in the palm of his hand was a jet-black spirit guide, which was exactly the same as the one Shen Qing kept privately. His face was entangled with extreme fear, but also revealed a trace of crazy ecstasy, and his appearance was extremely strange.
The spirit guides and chooses the Lord, and no ordinary person can touch it at will. These are Shen Qing's original words.
Lin Tianxing suddenly recalled Xue Ye's near-death experience. The strange pulsation in the ground clearly matched the signs before Chen Shitou's death.
Zhang Daoren, who was entrusted by Zhao Shichang to prospect, did not leave here. He took root on the black stone hillside and kept an eye on the mineral veins day and night, refusing to let go of the slightest movement.
The mutation occurred at midnight on March 20th.
The Taoist's compass needle flew wildly, and the tiny electric light exploded. He performed the formula for a moment, and his face suddenly turned pale. Where is the abnormal movement of the earth's veins! It is clearly an ancient being that has been sleeping for eternity and is about to break its seal and wake up!
Visions of heaven and earth swept across the entire continent simultaneously. The ancient bell of Qingtian Peak chimes without wind; the gigantic waves in the East China Sea crack out of thin air; the frozen soil in the Northern Territory rolls out the roar of ancient beasts; the stone chamber of the Demon King in the Southern Territory cracks with fine lines; the ten thousand-year-old stone statue in the Western Territory sheds tears of scarlet blood.
The overall situation of troubled times has begun.
Only Lin Tianxing from the Black Stone Mine was completely ignorant of this. Turning over late at night, unable to wake up. The eternal existence deep in the earth's core is using his heartbeat as the only coordinate to break free from the confinement of the thick rock formation inch by inch.
Only the last chance is left to appear in this world.
---
On the third day of April, Shen Qing's revenge plan that had been dormant for half a year finally revealed its true colors.
At the end of the day, he did not return to the slave hut. Taking advantage of the thick darkness, he quietly sneaked to the waste dump on the west side of the mine. Lin Tianxing followed quietly, and when he saw the scene in front of him clearly, his heart suddenly tightened.
Behind the rubbish pile, seven or eight figures were squatting.
They are all hardworking slaves struggling at the bottom of the mine. He was familiar with most of them: the honest and honest Li Dazhu, the lame Sun Laizi who pulled the mine, and the busy Widow Zhao in the kitchen. The remaining few faces were raw and their clothes were shabby, and they looked like they were poor craftsmen who had nowhere to go in the city.
Shen Qing stood in the middle of the crowd, with a mine layout map hand-drawn on rough cloth spread out in his palm. Half of the candlelight was flickering. He held the charcoal strip and marked four key points on the cloth.
"On the north side door, there is only one guard on duty at night." Shen Qing lowered his voice and spoke neatly, "The guard changes at three o'clock, leaving half a cup of tea unattended. This is our only chance to enter."
The charcoal strips draw a long line on the cloth.
"Sixteen people are permanently stationed in the mine protection barracks on the west side. These people drink and sleep soundly every night, and there are less than five people who can actually stand up and challenge. In Manager Zhao's bedroom on the south side, there is a copper key hidden under the pillow, which can open the core iron cabinet in the main hall."
"There are three things in the iron cabinet." Shen Qing raised his eyes and glanced at everyone, "The deeds of sale of all the mining slaves, the Zhao family's black account book of tax evasion and deduction, and the secret letter of collusion between officials and businessmen."
The long-suppressed hatred in his eyes suddenly became clear.
"With these three things, the Zhao family will be completely destroyed! The contract of sale can liberate all the slave workers; the black account can destroy all the Zhao family's properties; the secret letter can bring down all the corrupt officials in Tianqing City. The evidence will be posted at the market entrance, and the whole city will know it. No one can save the Zhao family!"
Li Dazhu licked his chapped lips, with timidity hidden in his eyes: "Dozens of people from the mine protection team have knives in their hands. We are unarmed, so what can we do to break in?"
Shen Qing remained silent and slowly took out something from his arms.
The palm-sized bronze mirror has a dull surface and a circle of obscure ancient patterns engraved on the edge. No one can tell its origin. He placed the bronze mirror flat on the ground, took out the dark spirit guide, and pressed it tightly against the back of the mirror.
In the cracks in the stone body, a ray of gold pattern suddenly lit up.
The mirror surface instantly ripples like falling rain on still water. There was no one in the mirror, only the thick dark red mist was slowly billowing, and all that was felt was a strange sense of oppression.
"What kind of magic weapon is this?" Lin Tianxing asked in a low voice, feeling inexplicably heavy in his heart.
"Taoist Zhang's private collection." Shen Qing's lips curled up with a cold arc, "That old Taoist thought I was ZhaoThe spies were completely defenseless. I drank with him for three days in a row and learned a lot of spiritual methods. "
"This is the low-level obscuring magic weapon he refined. Shen Qing tapped the mirror, "Injecting spiritual power can cover half of the mine, and mortals will fall asleep immediately after entering the barrier." When the time comes, it will automatically dissipate without leaving any trace. "
He added, his tone was plain but very weighty: "That Lao Zhang is a serious monk. Although his cultivation level is not high, it is more than enough to crush ordinary people. "
Lin Tianxing stared at the reddish bronze mirror, filled with doubts.
An unknown strange stone can actually drive a monk's magic weapon? How terrifying is the origin of this spirit?
He suppressed his doubts and listened quietly to the arrangements. Shen Qing's deployment was so meticulous that there were no flaws.
"Li Dazhu, you are the strongest. Lead two people to guard the north gate and deal with the changing guards. "
"Sun Laizi, you are familiar with the terrain of the mine. He led two people to squat outside the barracks, and after the barrier was spread, they collected all the weapons as soon as possible. "
“Widow Zhao, you are responsible for delivering the steward’s meals. You can keep this bag of Mongolian sweat medicine and add it to his meal tonight. The precise dose of medicine is enough for him to sleep until noon tomorrow. "
Finally, Shen Qing turned to look at Lin Tianxing.
"Tian Xing, follow me into the main hall. "
"Just the two of us? "Lin Tianxing was slightly startled.
"It's just the two of us. Shen Qing's eyes were firm, "The evidence in the courtroom is related to everyone's lives. The fewer people know, the lower the risk." After you get the things, you can take them out of the mine. If something goes wrong, the drainage ditch behind the mountain is the only way to survive. "
"What about you? "
Shen Qing was silent for a moment, and smiled lightly but decisively: "I picked up this life a long time ago. If something goes wrong, accept your fate. "
